_meta.description: Major world religions — beliefs, scriptures, figures, practices, and comparative topics

core_beliefs: Jesus Christ is the Son of God and savior
The Holy Trinity (Father, Son, Holy Spirit)
christianity.afterlife: Heaven and Hell; resurrection of the dead; eternal life
christianity.prayer_style: Direct address to God; communal and private; liturgy-based in many traditions
christianity.creation_myth: God created the world in six days (Genesis); Adam and Eve as first humans

description.en: The world's largest religion, centered on the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus Christ. Christians believe Jesus is the Son of God who died for humanity's sins and rose from the dead, offering eternal salvation. It has spread globally through missionary work and colonial history.
description.ko: 예수 그리스도의 삶, 죽음, 부활을 중심으로 한 세계 최대의 종교입니다. 기독교인들은 예수가 인류의 죄를 위해 죽고 부활하여 영원한 구원을 제공하는 하나님의 아들이라고 믿습니다.

core_beliefs: There is no god but Allah (Tawhid)
Five Pillars: Shahada, Salah, Zakat, Sawm, Hajj
Quran as the direct word of God
islam.afterlife: Paradise (Jannah) and Hell (Jahannam); resurrection and judgment by Allah
islam.prayer_style: Five daily prayers (Salah) facing Mecca; communal Friday prayers (Jumu'ah)
islam.creation_myth: Allah created the universe and humans (Adam and Hawwa) from clay

description.en: The second-largest religion, founded in 7th century Arabia by the Prophet Muhammad. Islam means 'submission to God.' Its adherents (Muslims) follow the Quran and the Five Pillars. Islam is the fastest-growing religion globally.
description.ko: 7세기 아라비아에서 예언자 무함마드에 의해 창시된 세계 제2의 종교입니다. 이슬람은 '신에 대한 복종'을 의미하며, 신자(무슬림)들은 쿠란과 다섯 기둥을 따릅니다.

hinduism.afterlife: Reincarnation (samsara) until moksha (liberation); heaven and hell as temporary states
hinduism.prayer_style: Puja (ritual worship), mantra recitation, meditation, temple visits
hinduism.creation_myth: Brahma (creator) emerges from lotus in Vishnu's navel; creates world from his own body

description.en: The world's oldest living religion, originating in the Indus Valley. Hinduism is a diverse family of traditions unified by belief in dharma, karma, and moksha. It encompasses philosophy, ritual, art, and social structure. Over 1 billion adherents make it the third-largest religion.
description.ko: 인더스 문명에서 기원한 세계에서 가장 오래된 살아있는 종교입니다. 힌두교는 다르마, 카르마, 목샤에 대한 믿음으로 통합된 다양한 전통의 집합체입니다.

core_beliefs: Four Noble Truths (dukkha, origin, cessation, path)
buddhism.afterlife: Reincarnation (samsara) until nirvana; rebirth determined by karma
buddhism.prayer_style: Meditation, chanting mantras, offering flowers/incense/candles, walking meditation
buddhism.creation_myth: No creation myth; universe is beginningless and endless cycle (samsara)

description.en: Founded by Siddhartha Gautama in ancient India, Buddhism teaches liberation from suffering through wisdom, ethical conduct, and meditation. It emphasizes direct experience over belief, with the goal of nirvana — the cessation of suffering and rebirth.
description.ko: 고대 인도에서 싯다르타 고타마에 의해 창시된 불교는 지혜, 윤리적 행동, 명상을 통한 고통에서의 해방을 가르칩니다. 고통과 윤회의 소멸인 열반을 목표로 합니다.

core_beliefs: Three pillars: Nam Japna, Kirat Karni, Vand Chakna
sikhism.afterlife: Reincarnation based on karma; merging with God (Waheguru) as the ultimate goal
sikhism.prayer_style: Nitnem (daily prayers), kirtan (hymn singing), Ardas (standing prayer)
sikhism.creation_myth: God created the universe through Hukam (divine will); existed before time

description.en: Founded by Guru Nanak in 15th century Punjab, Sikhism emphasizes devotion to one God, equality among all people, honest living, and selfless service. Sikhs are recognized by their turban and five articles of faith (Five Ks).
description.ko: 15세기 펀자브에서 구루 나낙에 의해 창시된 시크교는 유일신에 대한 헌신, 모든 사람의 평등, 정직한 삶, 이타적 봉사를 강조합니다.

core_beliefs: Covenant between God and the Jewish people
judaism.afterlife: Various views: Olam Ha-Ba (World to Come), resurrection; focus is on this-worldly action
judaism.prayer_style: Three daily services, synagogue-centered, Hebrew liturgy, facing Jerusalem
judaism.creation_myth: God created the world in six days and rested on the seventh (Shabbat)

description.en: One of the oldest Abrahamic religions, Judaism is centered on the covenant between God and the Jewish people, as recorded in the Torah. It is both a religion and a people's identity, emphasizing ethical monotheism, study of scripture, and communal life.
description.ko: 가장 오래된 아브라함 종교 중 하나인 유대교는 토라에 기록된 하나님과 유대 민족 사이의 언약을 중심으로 합니다. 윤리적 유일신론, 성경 연구, 공동체 생활을 강조합니다.

core_beliefs: Tao is the fundamental force underlying the universe
taoism.afterlife: Transformation of energy; immortality through cultivation (xian); return to Tao
taoism.prayer_style: Ritual offerings, meditation, Taichi/Qigong, consultation of oracles
taoism.creation_myth: Tao generates One, One generates Two (yin-yang), Two generates Three, Three generates all things

description.en: Rooted in ancient China, Taoism teaches harmony with the Tao — the natural flow of the universe. Its philosophy of wu wei (effortless action) and balance between opposites (yin-yang) has influenced Chinese culture, medicine, art, and martial arts.
description.ko: 고대 중국에서 유래한 도교는 우주의 자연적 흐름인 도와의 조화를 가르칩니다. 무위(無爲)와 음양의 균형 철학은 중국 문화, 의학, 예술, 무술에 깊은 영향을 미쳤습니다.

shinto.founder: No single founder; emerged from ancient Japanese folk beliefs
core_beliefs: Kami inhabit all things (nature, people, phenomena)
shinto.afterlife: Kami realm; ancestral spirits (hotoke); continuation as kami
shinto.prayer_style: Two bows, two claps, one bow at shrines; offerings (omamori, ema)
shinto.creation_myth: Izanagi and Izanami created the Japanese islands; Amaterasu created from Izanagi's left eye

description.en: Japan's indigenous religion, Shinto sees the divine (kami) as present in all aspects of the natural world. Rather than a set of doctrines, it is a way of living in harmony with nature, ancestors, and community. Most Japanese practice both Shinto and Buddhism.
description.ko: 일본 고유의 종교인 신토는 자연 세계의 모든 측면에 신성(가미)이 존재한다고 봅니다. 교리 체계보다는 자연, 조상, 공동체와의 조화 속에 사는 방식으로서, 대부분의 일본인은 신토와 불교를 함께 실천합니다.

core_beliefs: Good Thoughts, Good Words, Good Deeds (Humata, Hukhta, Hvarshta)
Cosmic battle between good (Ahura Mazda) and evil (Angra Mainyu)
Free will to choose between good and evil
Fire as sacred symbol of Ahura Mazda
zoroastrianism.afterlife: Judgment of the soul; heaven (Ahura Mazda's realm) or hell (temporarily); final resurrection
zoroastrianism.prayer_style: Five daily prayers (Geh), facing fire or sun, wearing sacred shirt (sudreh) and cord (kusti)
zoroastrianism.creation_myth: Ahura Mazda created the world and first human pair; Angra Mainyu introduced suffering

description.en: One of the world's oldest monotheistic religions, Zoroastrianism profoundly influenced Judaism, Christianity, and Islam. Its core ethic of Good Thoughts, Good Words, Good Deeds, and its concepts of heaven, hell, final judgment, and savior influenced later Abrahamic traditions.
description.ko: 세계에서 가장 오래된 유일신교 중 하나로, 유대교, 기독교, 이슬람에 깊은 영향을 미쳤습니다. 좋은 생각, 좋은 말, 좋은 행동의 핵심 윤리와 천국, 지옥, 최후의 심판, 구세주 개념은 이후 아브라함 전통에 영향을 주었습니다.

core_beliefs: Unity of God, religion, and humanity
All major religions teach the same truth
Progressive revelation through Manifestations of God
Elimination of prejudice of all kinds
major_branches: No sects (unity is a core principle)
bahai.afterlife: Soul continues its spiritual journey after death; heaven and hell are spiritual states
bahai.prayer_style: Obligatory daily prayers, meditation, fasting (March), community meetings
bahai.creation_myth: God created existence to know itself; humans created for spiritual development

description.en: Founded in 19th century Persia, the Bahá'í Faith teaches that all major religions are chapters of one unfolding divine plan. Its principles include the unity of humanity, equality of men and women, universal education, and harmony of science and religion.
description.ko: 19세기 페르시아에서 창시된 바하이 신앙은 모든 주요 종교가 하나의 전개되는 신성한 계획의 장들이라고 가르칩니다. 인류의 통일, 남녀평등, 보편적 교육, 과학과 종교의 조화가 핵심 원칙입니다.

core_beliefs: Karma as physical particles binding the soul
jainism.afterlife: Cycle of reincarnation; final liberation (moksha) as pure soul in Siddhashila
jainism.prayer_style: Puja with 8 substances, Navkar Mantra recitation, meditation
jainism.creation_myth: No creation; universe is eternal and uncreated; governed by natural laws

description.en: An ancient Indian religion emphasizing non-violence (ahimsa), truth, and self-discipline. Jains believe all living beings have souls and practice extreme care not to harm any creature. Despite small numbers, Jains have had outsized cultural influence in India.
description.ko: 비폭력(아힘사), 진리, 자기 수련을 강조하는 고대 인도 종교입니다. 자이나교도들은 모든 생명체가 영혼을 가지고 있다고 믿으며, 어떤 생명도 해치지 않으려고 극도로 주의합니다.

core_beliefs: Five Relationships (ruler-subject, parent-child, husband-wife, elder-younger, friend-friend)
confucianism.afterlife: Veneration of ancestors; focus on this-world ethics; afterlife less emphasized
confucianism.prayer_style: Ancestor rites, ceremonial offerings, ritual music and dance at temples
confucianism.creation_myth: No cosmogonic myth; focus on social order rather than origins
symbols: Four noble plants (bamboo, orchid, plum, chrysanthemum)

description.en: Confucianism is an ethical and philosophical system developed from the teachings of Confucius (551–479 BCE). More a system of social ethics than a religion, it emphasizes relationships, virtue, education, and proper governance. It profoundly shaped East Asian civilizations for 2,500 years.
description.ko: 공자(기원전 551-479년)의 가르침에서 발전한 윤리적·철학적 체계입니다. 종교보다는 사회 윤리 체계로서 관계, 덕, 교육, 올바른 통치를 강조하며 2,500년 동안 동아시아 문명을 깊이 형성했습니다.

name.ja: 先住民の宗教・アニミズム

indigenous.afterlife: Spirit world; ancestors remain active; cyclical view of life and death
indigenous.prayer_style: Ceremony, dance, chanting, drumming, offerings to nature spirits
indigenous.creation_myth: Extremely varied: emergence from earth, great sky beings, dreamtime creation

description.en: Encompassing hundreds of distinct spiritual traditions, indigenous religions share a reverence for nature, ancestors, and community. Animism — the belief that spirits inhabit all things — is a common thread. These traditions hold deep ecological wisdom developed over millennia.
description.ko: 수백 가지의 구별되는 영적 전통을 포괄하는 원주민 종교는 자연, 조상, 공동체에 대한 경외를 공유합니다. 모든 사물에 영이 깃들어 있다는 애니미즘이 공통 실마리이며, 수천 년에 걸쳐 발전된 깊은 생태적 지혜를 담고 있습니다.

name.ja: ウィッカ・ネオペイガニズム

core_beliefs: Wiccan Rede: 'An it harm none, do what ye will'
Threefold Law (what you send out returns threefold)
Reverence for nature and seasonal cycles
holy_days: Eight Sabbats: Samhain, Yule, Imbolc, Ostara, Beltane, Litha, Lughnasadh, Mabon
wicca.afterlife: Summerland (realm of the dead); reincarnation to continue learning
wicca.prayer_style: Casting circles, invoking deities, meditation, spellwork, ceremony
wicca.creation_myth: The Goddess and God as co-creators; eternal dance of birth, death, and rebirth

description.en: A modern pagan religion formalized by Gerald Gardner in the 1950s, drawing on pre-Christian European folk magic, mythology, and ceremonial magic. Wicca honors the cycles of nature through eight seasonal festivals and venerates a Goddess and God as dual aspects of divinity.
description.ko: 1950년대 제럴드 가드너가 공식화한 현대 이교 종교로, 기독교 이전의 유럽 민간 마법, 신화, 의례 마법을 기반으로 합니다. 위카는 여덟 계절 축제를 통해 자연의 순환을 기리고 신성의 두 측면으로서 여신과 신을 숭배합니다.

name.ja: ニューエイジ・スピリチュアリティ

new_age.founder: No single founder; emerged from counterculture
new_age.afterlife: Soul evolution through multiple lifetimes; ascension; merging with Source
new_age.creation_myth: Universe as consciousness manifesting; Big Bang as divine creation

description.en: An eclectic spiritual movement drawing from Eastern religions, Western esotericism, and modern psychology. New Age emphasizes personal spiritual development, holistic health, and interconnectedness. It incorporates practices from many traditions including astrology, crystals, meditation, and channeling.
description.ko: 동양 종교, 서양 밀교, 현대 심리학에서 영감을 받은 절충적 영성 운동입니다. 뉴에이지는 개인적 영적 발전, 전인적 건강, 상호 연결성을 강조하며, 점성술, 수정, 명상, 채널링 등 많은 전통의 수련을 통합합니다.

cao_dai.founder: Ngô Văn Chiêu and Lê Văn Trung
core_beliefs: One God (Cao Đài) underlying all religions
Five paths to salvation: Buddhism, Taoism, Confucianism, Christianity, Geniism
scriptures: Book of Heavenly and Earthly Teachings
cao_dai.afterlife: Spiritual evolution; reincarnation; ultimate return to Cao Đài
cao_dai.prayer_style: Four daily prayer sessions, colorful ceremonial robes, Divine Eye symbol
cao_dai.creation_myth: Cao Đài creates the universe; yin-yang as foundation of creation

description.en: Founded in 1926 in Vietnam, Cao Dai ('High Tower') is a syncretic religion combining elements of Buddhism, Taoism, Confucianism, Christianity, and spiritualism. Its eclectic mix includes veneration of figures like Victor Hugo and Joan of Arc as divine teachers.
description.ko: 1926년 베트남에서 창시된 까오다이교('높은 탑')는 불교, 도교, 유교, 기독교, 강신술의 요소를 결합한 종합 종교입니다. 빅토르 위고와 잔 다르크 같은 인물들을 신성한 스승으로 숭배하는 독특한 특징이 있습니다.

core_beliefs: Haile Selassie I is the returned Messiah
Africa (Zion) as true homeland of all people of African descent
rastafari.afterlife: This-worldly liberation (Zion); spiritual immortality of the righteous
rastafari.prayer_style: Nyahbinghi drumming and chanting, groundation sessions, reasoning circles
rastafari.creation_myth: Jah created humanity; Black Africans as chosen people; Babylon as the fall

description.en: A Jamaican spiritual and social movement born in the 1930s, Rastafari combines elements of Christianity with Pan-African identity. Adherents ('Rastas') view Haile Selassie I of Ethiopia as the reincarnated Jesus and await liberation and return to Africa.
description.ko: 1930년대에 자메이카에서 탄생한 영적·사회적 운동으로, 기독교 요소와 범아프리카 정체성을 결합합니다. 신자들('라스타')은 에티오피아의 하일레 셀라시에 1세를 재림한 예수로 보며 아프리카로의 해방과 귀환을 기다립니다.

core_beliefs: God the Parent created humanity to live the 'Joyous Life'
holy_days: Tenrikyo Grand Service (1st and 26th of each month)
holy_sites: Jiba (Tenri City, Nara, Japan) — the place of origin of humanity
tenrikyo.afterlife: Soul returns to God the Parent; no heaven/hell but divine borrowing of body
tenrikyo.prayer_style: Mikagura-uta (sacred songs and dance), prayer at the Jiba
tenrikyo.creation_myth: God the Parent created humanity at Jiba (Tenri) to observe the Joyous Life

description.en: Founded in 1838 by Nakayama Miki, Tenrikyo is a Japanese new religion teaching that God the Parent created humanity to live joyfully. It emphasizes spiritual purification, communal service (hinokishin), and healing. It has millions of followers in Japan and diaspora communities.
description.ko: 1838년 나카야마 미키에 의해 창시된 천리교는 신이 인류를 기쁘게 살도록 창조했다고 가르치는 일본 신종교입니다. 영적 정화, 공동 봉사, 치유를 강조합니다.

name.ja: ユニテリアン・ユニバーサリズム

core_beliefs: Inherent worth and dignity of every person
Justice, equity, and compassion in human relations
Free and responsible search for truth
World community with peace and liberty
scriptures: No single scripture; draws from all world traditions
holy_days: No fixed holy days; community-defined celebrations
holy_sites: No required holy sites; local congregations
unitarian_universalism.afterlife: Individual belief; common view: focus on this-world transformation
unitarian_universalism.prayer_style: Responsive readings, meditation, music, social justice action
unitarian_universalism.creation_myth: Individual interpretation; science and spirituality welcomed

description.en: A liberal religion formed from the merger of Unitarianism and Universalism in 1961, UU welcomes people of all faiths and none. It has no binding creed but affirms seven principles including the dignity of all persons. Known for progressive social justice work.
description.ko: 1961년 유니테리언주의와 유니버설리즘의 합병으로 형성된 자유주의 종교로, 모든 신앙을 가진 사람들을 환영합니다. 구속력 있는 신조가 없지만 모든 사람의 존엄성을 포함한 일곱 가지 원칙을 확언합니다.

core_beliefs: Human beings are immortal spiritual beings (thetans)
Dianetics: mind contains engrams causing suffering
Auditing process to clear negative experiences
scriptures: Dianetics: The Modern Science of Mental Health
scientology.afterlife: Thetans are immortal and can be reborn; OT levels reveal full spiritual truth
scientology.prayer_style: Auditing sessions (with E-meter), courses, study of Hubbard's technology
scientology.creation_myth: Xenu and body thetans (revealed at OT III level)

description.en: Founded by L. Ron Hubbard in 1953, Scientology teaches that humans are immortal spiritual beings (thetans) who have forgotten their true nature. Through auditing and courses, members work toward spiritual clarity. It is controversial and legally recognized as a religion in some countries.
description.ko: 1953년 L. 론 허바드에 의해 창시된 사이언톨로지는 인간이 자신의 진정한 본성을 잊은 불멸의 영적 존재(세탄)라고 가르칩니다. 감사와 과정을 통해 회원들은 영적 명료함을 향해 나아갑니다.

entries.summary_en: God created in 6 days; Adam & Eve
Allah created universe and first humans from clay
Brahma creates from Vishnu's lotus; cosmic cycles
Izanagi/Izanami create islands; Amaterasu from eye
Ahura Mazda creates; Angra Mainyu introduces evil
Return to Tao; immortality through cultivation
Ahimsa is the highest principle; extreme pacifism
Turn other cheek; just war permitted in some traditions
War permitted in self-defense (Jihad has defensive meaning)

entries.note_en: Quran as literal word of God
